company.name: Wemolo
company.tagline: Enabling seamless parking - We are hiring!
company.description:
Since 2019, Wemolo has been shaping the future of digital parking with AI-based license plate recognition and a modular full-service offering that ensures the efficient use of parking spaces. By optimizing utilization and significantly reducing administrative complexity for property owners, Wemolo has grown to a team of over 250 employees across the DACH region, Poland, and Italy.
Today, more than 3,500 parking facilities rely on Wemolo’s solution to record over 2.5 million transactions daily, establishing seamless processes for both operators and drivers. This has earned Wemolo recognition as the fastest-growing startup in Germany in the Deloitte Fast 50 ranking.
Our diverse customer base includes leading retailers, major real estate companies, restaurant groups, hotel chains, renowned healthcare institutions, as well as numerous financial service providers and municipalities across Europe.
